## Plugin reference

- Description: Steady reveal for text an agent is still writing: useSteadyReveal drains a growing text at an even pace over the bursts it arrives in, its newest words fading in through a soft tail painted with the CSS Custom Highlight API, in the foreground or muted tone. Shared by the streaming reply and the streaming thought.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --foreground`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --muted-foreground`
  - Imported by:
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/assistant-text`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/assistant-thinking`
- Web:
  - Exports (types): `RevealTone`
  - Exports (values): `useSteadyReveal`
